# CI: Dependency version links

Check if versions needed to be bumped from time to time

## GitHub Actions

| Action | Check latest versions |
| --- | --- |
| actions/checkout | https://github.com/actions/checkout/releases |
| actions/setup-node | https://github.com/actions/setup-node/releases |
| actions/setup-go | https://github.com/actions/setup-go/releases |
| actions/setup-java | https://github.com/actions/setup-java/releases |
| actions/upload-artifact | https://github.com/actions/upload-artifact/releases |
| actions/cache | https://github.com/actions/cache/releases |
| gradle/actions (setup-gradle) | https://github.com/gradle/actions/releases |
| golangci/golangci-lint-action | https://github.com/golangci/golangci-lint-action/releases |
| golangci/golangci-lint | https://github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/releases |
| aquasecurity/trivy-action | https://github.com/aquasecurity/trivy-action/releases |
